description: Principal PM-posture skill that answers a retired 根回し Nemawashi seed and re-reads the project's seedbed behind it — halts outside a principal-pm session or the principal-pm subagent. It runs after nemawashi-retire has filed the seed in `trail/`. It processes every recommendation the seed's shukuba-refine runs left for the Principal PM, re-reads every candidate in `unpicked/`, and acts: modify a candidate, drop one through nemawashi-drop, write a companion item on a product document, name a docs cut for work a document already states, cut work no product document should state through seeds-from-idea, route a cross-project ask, or ignore a recommendation with its reason. What it finds while reading it fixes, files in docs/findings/ or cuts — a dead journey pointer always repaired. It never cuts from the product's documents, never picks, never retires, and never writes into `trail/`, nor into `drop/` except through nemawashi-drop. It always writes one report, `system/projects/<project>/docs/nemawashi-refine/<seed>_report.md`, opening with the next moves — the companion sweep (chain-product or chain-agari, by the project card's Definition line), seeds-from-product-docs, nemawashi-pick and stations-from-seed, plus a halted cut's re-run or a route across projects where owed — each with its seat and the command that starts it.
